study: The paid momentum / price-spike alerts (Trade Ideas filters posted in the Discord channel) as BOOK names, traded on the operator's signal (not in or just under a known resistance block AND %R trending up): same rule, groups, controls, costs and pass bars as docs/studies/bro_sr_wr_prereg.json, applied to the alert feed.
registered_at: 2026-10-07, before any alert outcome or feature is computed
origin: Operator 10/7: subscription ends early February 2027; renewal gate R1 (review 12/15, decide by 1/5). The alert feed is the other half of what is paid for; recorded by the desk recorder since 2026-09-25.
data: ~/session_snapshots/DAY/recorder_discord.jsonl.gz on the mini (fields ts, et, symbol, line, price, age_sec, burst, card_brand). The archive 'price' is never used (SIP only).

alerts.fresh_rule: the screen reader re-reads old cards: an alert counts only at a capture with age_sec <= 120 (rows without age_sec count only if it is the symbol's first appearance that day); R = that capture's ts
alerts.population: the first fresh alert per symbol-day; ticker validation, dedupe and cleaning as in the Bro prereg (asset checks, >= 1 SIP trade that day)
alerts.classes_information: alert class by line text (regex, first match): 'spike' (Price Volatility Spike / Price Spike), 'new_high' (New Daily High / New Weekly High / NHOD), 'card' ([ELITE] / find_it_first cards), 'other'

rule: identical to bro_sr_wr_prereg.json at commit cbd07d1: on the book from R to 15:30 (alerts have no exit lines), PRIMARY = first 1-min close in 09:31-15:30 where SR_ok AND WR_trending on gridded IEX bars, groups T ($10+, <= 0.05%) / S ($2-10, <= 100 bp) / MEGA / excluded assigned once at the first RTH minute, cross-name same-minute CONTROL_primary drawn from OTHER ALERTED names, SIP fills (first trade >= t + 2 s), 15-min hold, cost = full SIP spread at entry + 1c under $5, halts, the same chart-check caveat for thin names
pass: the Bro pass bar per group (Bonferroni 2 within this feed): PRIMARY net15 > 0 with t >= the 2.24-equivalent in BOTH halves, PRIMARY minus CONTROL_primary >= +50 bp with t >= 2.24-equivalent pooled, >= 60 entries per half; FAIL if t <= -2 in either half; UNDERPOWERED if any MDE > 150 bp

periods.historical: sessions 2026-09-25 .. 2026-10-07 (about 9 sessions): INFORMATION ONLY (far too few)
periods.forward: every session from 2026-10-08; decides; halves = alternate forward sessions; reviewed at R1 (2026-12-15)

information_only: alert-moment entry (R + 2 s; premarket -> first RTH print, quote at entry)
no_retuning: everything above is fixed here; the 120 s freshness rule cannot be changed after seeing outcomes
prior: LOW: spike/burst alerts faded like everything else (9/27); the momentum source carried 59% of lifetime loss (cheap names + gap-through stops)
caveat_freshness: the 120 s age rule rarely binds: most symbols' first rows carry no age_sec (58/62 on 9/25, 87/93 on 10/6) and count as fresh as first appearances, including cards re-read at the 04:00 reader start-up; stated for the forward record
